/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re, urllib.request, uuid
url = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/'
before = urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
action_id = re.search(r'name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+)"'"', before).group(1)
marker = 'Fresh post ' + uuid.uuid4().hex
boundary = 'boundary' + uuid.uuid4().hex
fields = [(action_id, ''), ('title', marker), ('content', 'Visible immediately')]
body = b''
for name, value in fields:
    body += ('--' + boundary + '\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"' + name + '\"\\r\\n\\r\\n' + value + '\\r\\n').encode()
body += ('--' + boundary + '--\\r\\n').encode()
request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data; boundary=' + boundary, 'Origin': url.rstrip('/')}, method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
    print('action status:', response.status)
after = urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
print('new post on next page load:', marker in after)
if marker not in after:
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re, urllib.request, uuid
url = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/'
html = urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
action_id = re.search(r'name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+)"'"', html).group(1)
marker = 'Action response ' + uuid.uuid4().hex
boundary = 'boundary' + uuid.uuid4().hex
body = b''
for name, value in [(action_id, ''), ('title', marker), ('content', 'New content')]:
    body += ('--' + boundary + '\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"' + name + '\"\\r\\n\\r\\n' + value + '\\r\\n').encode()
body += ('--' + boundary + '--\\r\\n').encode()
request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data; boundary=' + boundary, 'Origin': url.rstrip('/')}, method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
    action_html = response.read().decode()
    print('new post in action response:', marker in action_html)
    print('action status:', response.status)
if marker not in action_html:
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY"
